integrity: Exact analytic proof with a self-contained standard-library rational-state verifier. Computations for n=5 through n=8 are not used in place of the all-n proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the two-subset Kneser family with independent equal-rate exponential arrival clocks has the claimed marked-time formula; the terminal-cardinality law extends to i.i.d. continuous priorities. Potential historical priority overlap through general RSA specializations remains possible; higher-rank Kneser graphs are not covered.
title: Two-scale jamming and rare maximality failure in the rank-two Kneser graph
